title: God Shall Wipe Away All Tears
firstLine: When we reach that home and lay our burdens down,

lines: When we reach that home and lay our burdens down,
God shall wipe away all tears;
When we join the saints and wear a robe and crown,
God shall wipe away all tears.
When the pearly gates unfold for you and me,
God shall wipe away all tears;
When we see the Christ who set the captive free
God shall wipe away all tears.
When we sweetly sing with all the ransomed throng,
God shall wipe away all tears;
No more partings come to mar that happy song,
God shall wipe away all tears.
God shall wipe away all the tears from ev'ry eye,
Give us joy for all our fears;
When we meet Him in that home beyond the sky,
God shall wipe away all tears.
